alias.description: the kind of key that is a NAME: a word an entity answers to, unique in the store and usable wherever an eid is. Write it as alias{name} on the entity itself — `{entity: {eid: '$r'}, alias: {name: 'recipe:lemon-cakes'}, doc: {…}}` — and the row is made for you; write the same name again and it lands on the same entity
